description:
Telekom HBS, part of the Telekom Group, is an ICT Systems Integrator offering a comprehensive suite of ICT Solutions and Services.

Telekom HBS, specializes in delivering ICT Services in areas such as Cloud, Data Centre operations, Networking, Cybersecurity, BI and Data Warehouse, Big Data, Service Desk, Proactive Monitoring, Operations and Support, Service Management, Project and Programme Management, and Professional Services. We are seeking a Senior AI/ML & LLM Security Engineer to join our team:

  • Strong Python/software development skills
  • Development of AI/LLM-based security tools and applications
  • Agentic AI and autonomous or semi-autonomous security workflows
  • MCP servers, tools and integrations
  • RAG and knowledge-based AI systems for cybersecurity
  • Integration with security platforms through APIs
  • AI-assisted detection engineering and security monitoring
  • AI-assisted incident investigation and response
  • Vulnerability analysis, prioritisation and remediation automation
  • Threat intelligence collection, enrichment and analysis
  • Malware, code and artefact analysis using AI/ML
  • Development of AI-enabled SOC capabilities and security copilots
  • Integration with SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management and other security tooling
  • AI-supported red teaming, penetration testing and attack simulation
  • AI automation supporting blue-team and purple-team activities
  • Secure deployment and operation of AI agents and LLM-based security applications
  • Practical understanding of LLM security risks and appropriate technical guardrails
  • Ability to take existing/open-source AI security solutions and substantially customise or extend them for our environment
